BDIAS horne in Sichem, of the tribe of Ephraim, prophecied the ſame time with Amot: ſs brieſhy that his prophecie is not parted chapters : againſt theI dumeans: foreſheming their deſtruchion : ro. for their peypetual emnite againff the fewes, and confederacie with the Cha- dees. The captiuitie aud relaxation of the ſemes.9. And redmptionf ihe mhole world by Chrift. and let vs ariſe againſt him into batrel. † Behold I haue geuen thee a litle one in the Gentils: thou art contēptible excedingly. † The pride of thy hart hath extolled thee, dwel- ling in the clefts of rockes, exalting thy throne : which ſayſt in their forces a- thy hart : Who shal plucke me downe to the earth † If thou HE viſion of Abdias. Thus ſayth our Lord God to Edom: We haue heard a bruit from our Lord, and he : hath ſent a legate to the Gentils: Riſe ye, galnſt the Idu- shalt be exalred as an eagle, and if thou shalt ſet thy neſt a- mong the ſtarres: thence wil I plucke thee downe, ſayth our Lord. † If theues had gone in to thee, if robbers by nighr, how hadſt thou held thy peace? would not they haue ſtolen thinges ſufficent for themſeluesꝰ if the grape gatherers had en- tered in to thee, would they not haue lefr thee at the leaſt a clu- ſter How haue they ſearched Eſau, haue they ſoughr out his hidden thinges † Euen to the border haue they caſt thee out: al themen of thy league haue mocked thee : the men of thy peace haue preuailed againſt thee : they thar eate with thee, shal lay ombuſhments vnder thee : there is no wiſedom in him. † Why, shal not I in thar day, ſayth our Lord, deſtroy the wiſe out of Idumea, and prudence from themount of Eſau, † And thy valients of the South shal feare, that man may pe- riſh from the mount of Eſau. † For the ſlaughter, and for the 10Gen. iniquitie againſt thy brother Iacob, confuſion shal couer thee, and thou shalt perish for euer. † In the day when thou ſtoodeſt againſt him, when ſtraugers tooke his armie, and foreners entered his gates, and vpon Ieruſalem caſt lotte: thou alſo waſtas one of them. † And thou shalt not dispiſe in the day of thy brother, in the day of his peregrination : and thou shalt not reioyce ouer the children of Iuda, in the day of their perdi- d,but miha tion: & thou shalt nor magnifie thy mouth in the day of diſtreſſe- † Neither
